userStories.title: Runner finish: result fields and no stray push for a workflow RUN
userStories.description:
**Goal** — JobRun.judge feeds workflow reasons into the verdict, and JobRun.finish reports nax's branch/sha for a workflow RUN without running the progress push or reading the finish ledger.

**Motivation** — With no finish ledger, `JobRun.finish` runs the #204 progress push, which commits the dirty tree (including the untracked `decisions.jsonl`, nax#2507) and pushes it onto the branch nax just published, adding a stray commit to nax's PR; and `resultPrUrl` never carries nax's PR link.

**Approach**
R3 (design, approved 2026-10-14): nax owns the push and the PR. koda never creates a second PR for a workflow run. The existing guard already holds once `resultPrUrl` is set: `FleetJobTicketEffects.upsertPrLinks` writes the fleet PR link on the job's tickets, and `hasFleetOwnership` then makes `createPrForTicket` return early.

`JobExecutor` (apps/runner/src/executor/job-executor.ts), `HostExecutor` and `FakeExecutor` target: add `readWorkflowResult(job: JobRow): Promise<WorkflowResult | null>` and `readHead(job: JobRow): Promise<string | null>` (the checkout's `HEAD` sha, null when git fails). `HostExecutor.readWorkflowResult(job)` = `findWorkflowResult(featureDirFor(repoDir, feature), Date.parse(job.createdAt))`, null on any filesystem error (feature from `job.assign.feature`; `HostExecutor.dirs(job)` gives `{ repoDir, jobDir, outDir }`). `FakeExecutor` target: scriptable `workflowResult` and `head` fields, and a recorded count of `readFinishLedger` calls.

`JobRun.judge(row)` reads `status`; when `row.command === 'RUN'` and `status.workflow` is present it also calls `executor.readWorkflowResult(row)` and passes its `reasons` (or none) as `workflowReasons` to `runVerdict`. `judge` returns `{ verdict, snapshot, workflow }`, where `workflow` is `status.workflow` (or undefined), so `finish` can branch on the workflow outcome rather than on the verdict (a finish-ledger ESCALATED must still push).

`JobRun.finish()` for a `RUN` whose status carries a `workflow` block and whose verdict is not CANCELLED (a cancelled RUN keeps today's path):
- outcome `ready` or `draft`: when `row.resultBranch` and `row.resultSha` are both non-null (a resumed finish), they are reused and `readHead` / `updateJob` are not called. Otherwise result branch = `row.branch`, result sha = `executor.readHead(row)`; when the sha is non-null both are journaled with `journal.updateJob(jobId, leaseEpoch, { resultBranch, resultSha })`; when it is null the report carries `resultBranch` = `row.branch` and no `resultSha`. **No progress push** (`pushRunProgress` is not called; `wipPush` stays unset). The finish ledger is not read.
- outcome `local-only` or no outcome: the finish ledger is not read and the progress push runs exactly as today (`pushRunProgress` owns journaling, so its resumed-finish guard keeps working).
- A RUN without a `workflow` block keeps today's path unchanged (finish ledger, then progress push when not COMPLETED or no ledger).

`mapStatusToSnapshot` resultPrUrl fallback to `status.workflow?.url` is implemented in US-001; this story only asserts it through the snapshot (AC-13).

**Scope** — In: JobExecutor/HostExecutor/FakeExecutor additions, JobRun.judge reasons, JobRun.finish workflow branch. Out: StatusView/runVerdict/findWorkflowResult (US-001, consumed here), stash and bundle (US-003), API and web. PLAN jobs unchanged. Existing finish cases (status without a workflow block) keep their expected snapshots.

**Interface**
```ts
// JobExecutor additions
readWorkflowResult(job: JobRow): Promise<WorkflowResult | null>;
readHead(job: JobRow): Promise<string | null>;

// JobRun.judge(row) returns
{ verdict, snapshot, workflow }   // workflow = status.workflow | undefined

// journal write used on a fresh finish when sha is non-null
journal.updateJob(jobId, leaseEpoch, { resultBranch, resultSha })
```

userStories.title: Runner stashes the workflow files into the job bundle
userStories.description:
**Goal** — The runner copies nax's workflow result, feature report and decisions log into the job dir and ships them in the RUN bundle, and clears them on requeue.

**Motivation** — The bundle carries none of the workflow files, so reasons and open items are lost when the runner clone is reused.

**Approach**
D2 (grounding): the run-level report nax writes is `<runDir>/feature-report.md` (per-story reports live under `<runDir>/US-00N/`). The bundle carries it under its real name. D3: `feature-report.md` and `decisions.jsonl` travel in the bundle (kept with the job's bundle artifact) and are not parsed by the API.

`stashWorkflowOutputs(repoDir, jobDir, feature, sinceMs)` (new, apps/runner/src/executor/workflow-stash.ts): when `findWorkflowResult(featureDirFor(repoDir, feature), sinceMs)` (US-001, apps/runner/src/verdict/workflow-result.ts) finds a result, copies that run dir's `result.json` and `feature-report.md` (when present), and `<featureDir>/decisions.jsonl` (when present and its mtime is at or after `sinceMs`), to `<jobDir>/workflow/` under the same three names. Each source is checked with `lstat`: anything that is not a regular file, or is larger than 1 MiB, is skipped. It never writes inside `repoDir`, never runs git, and returns the names it copied (empty, and no folder created, when there is no result). It mirrors `stashPlanOutputs(repoDir, jobDir, feature)` in apps/runner/src/executor/plan-commit.ts (copy into the job dir, never commit). `featureDirFor(repoDir, feature)` (apps/runner/src/paths/safe-segment.ts) -> `<repoDir>/.nax/features/<feature>`.

`HostExecutor.collectBundle(job)` target: for a `RUN` it first calls `stashWorkflowOutputs(repoDir, jobDir, feature, sinceMs)` with `sinceMs = Date.parse(job.createdAt)` before `buildBundle`.

`ATTEMPT_FILES` (apps/runner/src/executor/host-executor.ts) baseline: `['nax-out', 'nax.stdout', 'nax.stderr', 'pre-plan', 'plan-out', 'plan-out.tmp', 'plan-logs', 'plan-logs.tmp', 'bundle.tar.gz', 'bundle.list', 'bundle-manifest.json']`. Target: the same list plus `'workflow'`, so a requeued attempt never bundles the previous attempt's workflow files.

`collectBundleEntries(jobDir, command)` (apps/runner/src/bundle/build-bundle.ts) baseline: `nax-out/**` minus prompt-audit, `nax.stdout`, `nax.stderr`, PLAN `plan-logs/*.jsonl`. Target: additionally, for `RUN`, each of `workflow/result.json`, `workflow/feature-report.md`, `workflow/decisions.jsonl` that exists in `jobDir`. A RUN job dir without a workflow folder keeps today's exact list; PLAN never includes them.

**Scope** — In: workflow-stash.ts, HostExecutor.collectBundle call, collectBundleEntries, ATTEMPT_FILES. Out: findWorkflowResult itself (US-001), JobRun finish and readWorkflowResult/readHead (US-002), API ingest of the bundle (US-004/US-005). Per-story reports and other run-dir files are not bundled.

**Interface**
```ts
// apps/runner/src/executor/workflow-stash.ts (new)
export async function stashWorkflowOutputs(repoDir: string, jobDir: string, feature: string, sinceMs: number): Promise<readonly string[]>; // names copied: 'result.json' | 'feature-report.md' | 'decisions.jsonl'
```
acceptanceCriteria: stashWorkflowOutputs over a checkout holding `workflow/<id>/result.json` and `workflow/<id>/feature-report.md` (both after `sinceMs`) and `decisions.jsonl` (after `sinceMs`) copies all three to `<jobDir>/workflow/` and returns the names `result.json`, `feature-report.md` and `decisions.jsonl` in any order

stashWorkflowOutputs with `decisions.jsonl` whose mtime is before `sinceMs` copies `result.json` and not `decisions.jsonl`
stashWorkflowOutputs with `feature-report.md` being a symlink to a file outside the checkout does not copy `feature-report.md`

stashWorkflowOutputs over a feature dir with no `workflow/` folder returns an empty list and creates no `<jobDir>/workflow/` folder

HostExecutor.collectBundle of a RUN job whose checkout holds a workflow `result.json` written after `createdAt` produces a bundle whose manifest `entries` include `workflow/result.json`
HostExecutor preparing a requeued attempt (a new lease epoch over a job dir that holds `workflow/result.json`) leaves no `workflow` folder in the job dir before nax starts

userStories.title: API: FleetJob.workflow column, DTO and result.json parser
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add a nullable `FleetJob.workflow` JSONB column carried through domain, repository, DTO and requeue, plus the `result.json` parser, the `workflowResult` bundle slot, and the `parseStatus` workflow fields.

**Motivation** — The API has nowhere to store or expose nax's workflow verdict (reasons and open items), so a human cannot see why a workflow run was a draft.

**Approach**
D3: the API parses only `result.json`; `feature-report.md` and `decisions.jsonl` travel in the bundle and are not parsed. nax input `result.json` (`WorkflowResultFile`, `schemaVersion: 1`); `verdict` is absent until the feature workflow publishes:
```json
{ "schemaVersion": 1, "runId": "fab5b9af-d3a3-41f2-91ed-62372a733c03", "feature": "fleet-s5a-thread-handoff",
  "stories": {},
  "verdict": { "workflowPassed": true, "outcome": "draft",
               "reasons": ["CI failed: test"],
               "openItems": [ { "id": "_run:cv1", "kind": "cannot-verify", "severity": "minor",
                                "file": "apps/api/src/x.ts", "line": 12, "issue": "DB-backed specs not run",
                                "suggestion": "run test:integration" } ] } }
```
`OpenItem.kind` is one of `finding | ruling | cannot-verify | gate`; `severity`, `file`, `line`, `suggestion` and `ruling` are optional. `FeatureOutcome` is `ready | draft | local-only`.

Migration `20261016090000_fleet_job_workflow` (sorts after `20261015090000_thread_handoff`): `ALTER TABLE "FleetJob" ADD COLUMN "workflow" JSONB;` (nullable, no default). Add a nullable Json `workflow` field to the FleetJob model in apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma next to `postRun`.

The new `workflow` column follows the `FleetJobPostRun` / `postRun` precedent (`fleet-job.domain.ts`, `prisma-fleet-job.repository.ts`, `fleet-job.dto.ts`): domain field, `Mutable` key, repository JSON mapping with `Prisma.DbNull`, DTO field null in `FleetJobDto.summary`, reset to null on requeue. `FleetJobRecord`, `Mutable`, `FleetJobPatch` (fleet-job.domain.ts): add `workflow: FleetJobWorkflow | null` and `'workflow'` to `Mutable`. `FleetJobsService.requeue` (fleet-jobs.service.ts): the requeue patch that resets the per-attempt fields (`resultPrUrl`, `postRun`, ...) also sets `workflow: null`. `FleetJobDto.from` maps `workflow: r.workflow ?? null`; `summary` sets it to null (list pages). `FleetJobWorkflowDto` / `FleetJobWorkflowItemDto` mirror the domain types with Swagger decorators; `openapi.json` is regenerated (`bun run generate` at the repo root; never hand-edit generated CLI client files).

`parseWorkflowResult(file: BundleFile | null): FleetJobWorkflow | null` (new, apps/api/src/fleet/ingest/parsers/workflow.parser.ts) uses the `fields.ts` readers: `schemaVersion` must be `1`, `runId` a string (at most `INGEST_LIMITS.idText`), `verdict.outcome` one of the three values, `verdict.workflowPassed` a boolean; `reasons` keeps at most 20 strings of at most 500 characters; `openItems` keeps at most 50 entries whose `id`, `kind`, `issue` are strings (`id`/`kind`/`severity` at most `shortText`, `issue`/`suggestion` at most `reasonText`, `file` at most 512, `line` via `nonNegInt`); missing optional fields become `null`; an item whose `id`, `kind` or `issue` is missing or empty after trimming is dropped (the `str` reader returns null for an empty string). Anything else -> `null`.

`BundleFiles` / `slotOf` (apps/api/src/fleet/ingest/bundle-reader.ts): target adds slot `workflowResult` for the exact name `workflow/result.json` and field `workflowResult: BundleFile | null`; `readBundleFiles` stores it as a single file (like `metrics` and `status`), not by appending to an array. `workflow/feature-report.md` and `workflow/decisions.jsonl` stay unallowlisted (slotOf returns null).

`parseStatus` (apps/api/src/fleet/ingest/parsers/finish.parser.ts): baseline returns `{ runId, runStatus }`; target returns `{ runId, runStatus, workflowOutcome: 'ready' | 'draft' | 'local-only' | null, workflowUrl: string | null }` (`workflowUrl` https only, at most `INGEST_LIMITS.reasonText`; both null when the status has no workflow block). `INGEST_PARSER_VERSION` (apps/api/src/fleet/ingest/domain/bundle-ingest.domain.ts): `1` -> `2`.

**Scope** — In: migration, schema.prisma, domain/repository/DTO/requeue, workflow.parser.ts, bundle-reader slot, parseStatus fields, INGEST_PARSER_VERSION, openapi.json and CLI client regeneration. Out: wiring into parseBundle/computeCorrection/BundleIngestService and the ESCALATED correction (US-005); web rendering (US-006). Existing parsers.spec.ts exact-object expectations gain `workflowOutcome: null, workflowUrl: null`; bundle-reader.spec.ts slot list gains workflowResult.

**Interface**
```ts
// apps/api/src/fleet/jobs/domain/fleet-job.domain.ts
export interface FleetJobWorkflowItem { id: string; kind: string; issue: string; severity: string | null; file: string | null; line: number | null; suggestion: string | null }
export interface FleetJobWorkflow { runId: string; outcome: 'ready' | 'draft' | 'local-only'; workflowPassed: boolean; reasons: string[]; openItems: FleetJobWorkflowItem[] }
// FleetJobRecord gains: workflow: FleetJobWorkflow | null ; Mutable gains 'workflow'

// apps/api/src/fleet/ingest/parsers/workflow.parser.ts
export function parseWorkflowResult(file: BundleFile | null): FleetJobWorkflow | null;

// finish.parser.ts parseStatus returns
{ runId, runStatus, workflowOutcome: 'ready' | 'draft' | 'local-only' | null, workflowUrl: string | null }
```

userStories.title: API: ingest stores the workflow result and corrects a draft to ESCALATED
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Bundle ingest stores the parsed workflow result on the job, fills `resultPrUrl` from nax's PR url, and corrects a COMPLETED RUN whose workflow outcome is `draft` to ESCALATED.

**Motivation** — nax writes `run.status: "completed"` even when the workflow ends as a draft (nax#2508), so a draft run reads as COMPLETED and no human is told; the job and its tickets never get nax's PR link.

**Approach**
R1: a `draft` outcome maps to ESCALATED (existing needs-a-human state and notification; no new notification kinds). R3: nax owns the PR; once `resultPrUrl` is set, `FleetJobTicketEffects.upsertPrLinks` (apps/api/src/fleet/tickets/fleet-job-ticket.effects.ts, called by `BundleIngestService` after ingest, unchanged) writes the fleet PR link on the job's tickets and `hasFleetOwnership` makes `createPrForTicket` return early.

`ParsedBundle` / `parseBundle` (apps/api/src/fleet/ingest/parse-bundle.ts) target adds `workflow: FleetJobWorkflow | null` (from `parseWorkflowResult`, US-004), `workflowOutcome` and `workflowUrl` (from `parseStatus`, US-004), and the `files.workflow` outcome: `absent` when no `workflow/result.json`, `invalid` when present but `parseWorkflowResult` returns null, else `done`; `invalid` does not make the ingest partial.

`computeCorrection` gains `workflow: FleetJobWorkflow | null`, `workflowOutcome` and `workflowUrl` inputs and `job.workflow` in `CorrectionInput['job']`; `BundleIngestService` passes them from the parsed bundle. With the existing lease-epoch guard first (a bundle of an older lease epoch yields an empty patch), for a `RUN` job:
1. `workflow` patch: set when `job.workflow` is null and the parsed `workflow` is non-null (fill-only, like `fill`).
2. `resultPrUrl`: filled from `workflowUrl` when `job.resultPrUrl` is null (fill-only).
3. State: when `workflowOutcome === 'draft'` and `job.state` is COMPLETED -> `{ state: ESCALATED, stateReason: 'workflow draft (from status)' }` and `escalated: true`; `Correction` gains `escalatedFrom: 'finish-audit' | 'workflow' | null`.
4. The `NOTHING_PUSHED` reason is never applied when `workflowOutcome` is non-null.
5. The finish-based fields and escalation keep today's rules when `workflowOutcome` is null.

`BundleIngestService` records the escalation activity with `payload.source` equal to `escalatedFrom` (today the literal `'finish-audit'`). Exported constant `ESCALATED_FROM_WORKFLOW = 'workflow draft (from status)'`. `INGEST_PARSER_VERSION` is 2 (set in US-004) so `rerun-outdated` can re-ingest older bundles.

**Scope** — In: parseBundle wiring, computeCorrection workflow rules, BundleIngestService inputs and activity source, ESCALATED_FROM_WORKFLOW. Out: the column/DTO/parsers (US-004), runner work, web. PLAN jobs get no workflow patch and no state change. Existing ingest-corrections.spec.ts cases pass null workflow inputs and keep their patches; parse-bundle.spec.ts expected files map gains `workflow: 'absent'`.

analysis:
Koda fleet must read nax workflow-mode output (execution.mode 'workflow', nax >= 0.88.0-canary.1). In workflow mode nax pushes the branch and opens/promotes the PR itself, writes a `workflow` block ({step, stories, outcome, url}) into status.json instead of postRun.finish, and writes the verdict to <repo>/.nax/features/<feature>/workflow/<workflowRunId>/result.json. Today the runner mis-reports these: runVerdict (apps/runner/src/verdict/run-verdict.ts) returns COMPLETED for run.status 'completed' with no postRun.finish (nax#2508: status is 'completed' even for a draft); JobRun.finish (apps/runner/src/supervisor/job-run.ts) runs the #204 progress push when there is no finish ledger, committing the untracked decisions.jsonl (nax#2507) on top of nax's push; resultPrUrl only comes from postRun.finish.url (apps/runner/src/watcher/status-snapshot.ts); the bundle carries no workflow files.

Rulings binding every story: R1 draft->ESCALATED, ready->COMPLETED, local-only or workflow block without outcome->FAILED. R2 no profile injection / no toggle; detect by presence of the status.json `workflow` block, keep today's behaviour when absent. R3 nax owns push and PR; koda never creates a second PR: once resultPrUrl is set, FleetJobTicketEffects.upsertPrLinks writes the fleet PR link and hasFleetOwnership makes createPrForTicket return early (unchanged). D1: status.json run.id is NOT the workflow run id (the dir name is a runtime UUID), so never build a path from naxRunId; locate result.json as the newest regular file workflow/*/result.json with mtime >= job row createdAt. D2: run-level report is <runDir>/feature-report.md. D3: API parses only result.json; feature-report.md and decisions.jsonl only travel in the bundle. D4: server keeps at most 500 chars of a runner state reason (apps/api/src/fleet/sync/event-payloads.ts), so the runner clips the whole reason, prefix included, to 500.

RUNNER (apps/runner, bun:test, Bun-only ESM): StatusView/parseStatusView (src/verdict/status-view.ts) gains optional WorkflowView {step, outcome?, url?} (outcome outside ready|draft|local-only dropped; url kept only if it starts with https://). New src/verdict/workflow-result.ts with parseWorkflowResult and findWorkflowResult (readdir withFileTypes, real dirs only, lstat regular file <= 1 MiB, mtime >= sinceMs, newest first, first that parses wins; a newer verdict-less file is passed over). runVerdict gains workflowReasons and a workflow table that ignores run.status/postRun; cancel row stays first. mapStatusToSnapshot: resultPrUrl = finish?.url ?? workflow?.url. JobExecutor (src/executor/job-executor.ts), HostExecutor (src/executor/host-executor.ts) and FakeExecutor (test/helpers/fake-executor.ts) gain readWorkflowResult(job) and readHead(job); FakeExecutor gets scriptable workflowResult/head and a readFinishLedger call counter. JobRun.judge returns {verdict, snapshot, workflow}; JobRun.finish for a non-cancelled RUN with a workflow block: ready/draft -> reuse row.resultBranch/resultSha if both non-null (resumed finish), else resultBranch=row.branch and sha=readHead (journal both via journal.updateJob(jobId, leaseEpoch, {resultBranch, resultSha}) only when sha non-null), no pushRunProgress, no ledger read; local-only/no outcome -> no ledger read, progress push as today; cancelled RUN and RUN without workflow block keep today's path. New src/executor/workflow-stash.ts (mirrors stashPlanOutputs in plan-commit.ts: copy into jobDir, never write in repoDir, never run git, lstat each source, skip non-regular or > 1 MiB, decisions.jsonl only if mtime >= sinceMs); HostExecutor.collectBundle calls it for RUN before buildBundle; ATTEMPT_FILES gains 'workflow'; collectBundleEntries (src/bundle/build-bundle.ts) adds workflow/result.json, workflow/feature-report.md, workflow/decisions.jsonl for RUN when present. Existing tests: verdict.spec.ts, job-run.spec.ts, status-snapshot.spec.ts, test/unit/host-executor.spec.ts, build-bundle.spec.ts must keep passing for statuses without a workflow block.

API (apps/api, NestJS + Prisma, vitest; DB-backed specs need `bun run test:db:up` + KODA_DB_TESTS=1): new nullable JSONB column FleetJob.workflow (migration 20261016090000_fleet_job_workflow, sorts after 20261015090000_thread_handoff). Follow the postRun precedent end to end: domain field (fleet-job.domain.ts), Mutable key, repository JSON mapping with Prisma.DbNull (prisma-fleet-job.repository.ts), DTO field (null in FleetJobDto.summary), reset to null in FleetJobsService.requeue. New parsers/workflow.parser.ts using fields.ts readers. bundle-reader.ts gets slot workflowResult for the exact name workflow/result.json (single file like metrics/status; feature-report.md and decisions.jsonl stay unallowlisted -> slotOf null). parseStatus (parsers/finish.parser.ts) additionally returns workflowOutcome and workflowUrl (https only, <= INGEST_LIMITS.reasonText); existing parsers.spec.ts exact-object assertions gain two null fields. parseBundle adds workflow/workflowOutcome/workflowUrl and files.workflow (absent|invalid|done; invalid does not make ingest partial). computeCorrection (ingest-corrections.ts): after the lease-epoch guard, for RUN: fill-only workflow patch, fill-only resultPrUrl from workflowUrl, COMPLETED + workflowOutcome 'draft' -> ESCALATED with stateReason ESCALATED_FROM_WORKFLOW ('workflow draft (from status)'), escalated true, Correction.escalatedFrom 'finish-audit'|'workflow'|null; NOTHING_PUSHED never applied when workflowOutcome non-null; finish-based rules unchanged when workflowOutcome null. BundleIngestService records the escalation activity with payload.source = escalatedFrom (today literal 'finish-audit'). INGEST_PARSER_VERSION 1 -> 2. openapi.json is regenerated via `bun run generate` at repo root (also regenerates CLI client; never hand-edit generated files). API i18n not needed (no new API strings).

WEB (apps/web, Nuxt 3, Jest per package config; tests use mountSfc from tests/helpers/mount-sfc.ts, which has no Nuxt auto-import so components must be imported explicitly and added to FLEET_COMPONENT_FILES): FleetJobDto in lib/fleet-types.ts gains workflow + FleetJobWorkflowDto/FleetJobWorkflowItemDto; new components/fleet/FleetJobWorkflow.vue rendered by pages/[project]/fleet/jobs/[id]/index.vue below the state row when job.workflow is non-null; i18n keys in en.json and zh.json (parity enforced by tests/i18n/fleet-locale-parity.spec.ts and used-keys-exist.spec.ts). Page tests follow fleet-job-logs-page.spec.ts (alias stubs for useApi, useFleetApprovals, JobAnalytics.vue, ConfigPrDialog.vue; globals for other composables).

Risks: (1) the spec's AC set is authoritative over prose; (2) US-002's finish branch must key on status.workflow.outcome, not on the verdict, because a finish-ledger ESCALATED must still push; (3) lstat/symlink handling and the 1 MiB cap are security-relevant filesystem guards (runner reads untrusted checkout content) - keep them in findWorkflowResult and stashWorkflowOutputs; (4) reason prefixes must never start with the budget-stop text the web page parses (budgetStopPolicyId); (5) mutations: follow the repo's immutable style, no console.log; (6) migration ordering and openapi.json/CLI regeneration in US-004 or CI drift checks fail. Story dependency graph: US-001 -> US-002, US-003; US-004 -> US-005, US-006. Build gate per story: bun run type-check and bun run lint in its workdir; US-004 additionally bunx prisma validate, bun run db:generate in apps/api and bun run generate at repo root.
outOfScope: The API creating or adopting a pull request for a workflow run (no find-or-create): nax owns the PR, and the existing `hasFleetOwnership` guard prevents a second PR once `resultPrUrl` is set.
A per-project or per-job toggle, or the API/runner adding a `workflow` profile to a job: nax decides the mode.
Parsing `feature-report.md` or `decisions.jsonl` on the API: they are only carried in the bundle.
Fixing nax#2507 (untracked decisions.jsonl) or nax#2508 (run.status completed for a draft): koda works around both.
PLAN jobs: their verdict, push and bundle are unchanged.
The C3 thread page (action bar, RUN card): it reuses `FleetJobWorkflow.vue` later.
New notification kinds: a draft uses the existing ESCALATED outcome notification.
A runner nax-version gate: detection is by the presence of the `status.json` `workflow` block.
Backfilling the `workflow` column for already-ingested jobs beyond what `rerun-outdated` does.
Per-story workflow reports (`<runDir>/US-00N/report.md`) and the other run-dir files (`ledger.md`, `*.diff`, `branch-review.json`): not bundled.
